calculo-diferencial.name: Differential Calculus
calculo-diferencial.description: Limits, continuity and derivatives to model change. Mathematical foundation for physics, graphics and algorithm analysis.

algebra.name: Algebra
algebra.description: University algebra: equations, functions and algebraic structures used in programming and later discrete mathematics.

analisis-y-diseno-de-algoritmos.name: Analysis and Design of Algorithms
analisis-y-diseno-de-algoritmos.description: How to frame a problem, design a step-by-step solution and measure efficiency. The plan's first course in computational thinking.

redaccion.name: Writing
redaccion.description: Clear, correct writing: reports, arguments and documentation an engineer needs to communicate.

fisica.name: Physics
fisica.description: Mechanics and physical principles that later appear in simulation, video games and real-world modelling.

historia-de-la-cultura.name: History of Culture
historia-de-la-cultura.description: UP humanistic formation: cultural and historical context for placing technology in society.

calculo-integral.name: Integral Calculus
calculo-integral.description: Integrals and applications: area, accumulation and tools for probability, physics and numerical methods.

entorno-economico.name: Economic Environment
entorno-economico.description: How the economic environment works where software products are sold and business decisions are made.

programacion-orientada-a-objetos.name: Object-Oriented Programming
programacion-orientada-a-objetos.description: Classes, objects, inheritance and modular design. Foundation for most of the software in the rest of the programme.

programacion-avanzada.name: Advanced Programming
programacion-avanzada.description: Programming techniques beyond the introductory level: abstraction, libraries and code ready for larger projects.

circuitos-digitales-y-electricos.name: Digital and Electrical Circuits
circuitos-digitales-y-electricos.description: Digital logic and circuits: how the machine represents bits and executes instructions beneath the software.

modelacion-digital.name: Digital Modelling
modelacion-digital.description: Represent shapes and scenes in 2D/3D with digital tools. Entry point to the programme's graphics track.

persona-y-sociedad.name: Person and Society
persona-y-sociedad.description: UP anthropological formation: person, community and the engineer's social responsibility.

algebra-lineal.name: Linear Algebra
algebra-lineal.description: Vectors, matrices and transformations. Core mathematics for graphics, vision, AI and simulation.

desarrollo-de-aplicaciones-web.name: Web Application Development
desarrollo-de-aplicaciones-web.description: Build applications in the browser and on the server: interfaces, APIs and digital products on the web.

programacion-y-estructura-de-datos.name: Programming and Data Structures
programacion-y-estructura-de-datos.description: Lists, trees, graphs, hash tables and how to choose the right structure for performance and clarity.

proyectos-de-inversion-e-introduccion-a-.name: Investment Projects and Introduction to Business Valuation
proyectos-de-inversion-e-introduccion-a-.description: Assess whether a project or company is worth pursuing: costs, return and basic valuation for entrepreneurship or investment decisions.

quimica.name: Chemistry
quimica.description: Chemical principles in engineering formation; scientific context alongside physics and mathematics.

direccion-de-proyectos.name: Project Management
direccion-de-proyectos.description: Plan, estimate and coordinate technical work: scope, timelines, team and delivery.

etica.name: Ethics
etica.description: Moral judgement for professional, data, product and social-impact conflicts.

calculo-vectorial.name: Vector Calculus
calculo-vectorial.description: Vector fields, curves and surfaces. Tool for geometry, physics and 3D graphics.

matematicas-de-la-computacion.name: Mathematics for Computing
matematicas-de-la-computacion.description: Discrete mathematics for computing: logic, combinatorics, graphs and foundations of languages and algorithms.

introduccion-a-las-bases-de-datos.name: Introduction to Databases
introduccion-a-las-bases-de-datos.description: Model, query and persist information: relational design and database use in applications.

multimedios-y-graficas-computacionales.name: Multimedia and Computer Graphics
multimedios-y-graficas-computacionales.description: Image, audio, video and the graphics pipeline: how the computer generates and combines media.

sistemas-operativos.name: Operating Systems
sistemas-operativos.description: Processes, memory, files and concurrency: the software that manages the hardware.

desarrollo-de-plugins.name: Plugin Development
desarrollo-de-plugins.description: Extend existing tools (engines, DCC or hosts) with plugins: APIs, packaging and integration.

antropologia-teologica-i.name: Theological Anthropology I
antropologia-teologica-i.description: UP identity block: person and meaning, in dialogue with professional formation.

probabilidad-y-estadistica.name: Probability and Statistics
probabilidad-y-estadistica.description: Uncertainty, sampling and inference. Foundation for AI, data science and probabilistic models.

ecuaciones-diferenciales.name: Differential Equations
ecuaciones-diferenciales.description: Models of systems that change over time: physics, control and simulation.

ingenieria-de-software.name: Software Engineering
ingenieria-de-software.description: Requirements, design, quality and process for building software that teams can maintain and deliver.

procesamiento-de-imagenes.name: Image Processing
procesamiento-de-imagenes.description: Filters, transformation and analysis of digital images. Bridge between graphics and computer vision.

metodos-numericos.name: Numerical Methods
metodos-numericos.description: Approximate solutions on a computer: roots, linear systems, interpolation and numerical integration.

desarrollo-de-videojuegos.name: Video Game Development
desarrollo-de-videojuegos.description: Gameplay, engines and game production: integrating graphics, input and logic into a playable product.

antropologia-teologica-ii.name: Theological Anthropology II
antropologia-teologica-ii.description: Continues the theological and anthropological formation of the UP common core.

algebra-geometrica-conformal.name: Conformal Geometric Algebra
algebra-geometrica-conformal.description: Geometric algebra to represent transformations, spheres and 3D geometry in a unified way. Distinctive of the graphics plan.

soluciones-graficas-para-moviles.name: Mobile Graphics Solutions
soluciones-graficas-para-moviles.description: Graphics and interfaces on phones and tablets: performance, mobile GPU and visual experiences in apps.

geometria-computacional.name: Computational Geometry
geometria-computacional.description: Algorithms on points, polygons and space: hulls, intersections, triangulation and spatial queries.

computo-distribuido.name: Distributed Computing
computo-distribuido.description: Systems across multiple machines: networking, consistency, failures and cloud computing.

seminario-de-aplicaciones-alternativas.name: Seminar on Alternative Applications
seminario-de-aplicaciones-alternativas.description: Projects and unconventional uses of computing and graphics: exploring industry, art, health and other domains.

realidad-aumentada.name: Augmented Reality
realidad-aumentada.description: Overlay graphics on the real world: tracking, camera registration and interaction in AR.

filosofia-social.name: Social Philosophy
filosofia-social.description: Society, common good and critique of institutions; framework for technology's impact.

inteligencia-artificial-en-videojuegos.name: Artificial Intelligence in Video Games
inteligencia-artificial-en-videojuegos.description: Agents, pathfinding, decision-making and behaviour for NPCs and game systems.

fundamentos-de-programacion-en-paralelo.name: Fundamentals of Parallel Programming
fundamentos-de-programacion-en-paralelo.description: Split work across threads and cores: synchronisation, GPU/CPU and the mental model of parallelism.

diseno-de-interfaces.name: Interface Design
diseno-de-interfaces.description: Design human-computer interaction: usability, prototypes and interfaces for software and immersive experiences.

graficacion-avanzada-por-computadora.name: Advanced Computer Graphics
graficacion-avanzada-por-computadora.description: Advanced rendering pipeline: lighting, shaders, GPU and high-quality image techniques.

tecnicas-de-interpretacion-avanzadas.name: Advanced Interpretation Techniques
tecnicas-de-interpretacion-avanzadas.description: Advanced interpretation techniques (visual or computational) applied to the programme's graphics-technical track. The PDF does not detail the syllabus.

hombre-y-mundo-contemporaneo.name: Humanity and the Contemporary World
hombre-y-mundo-contemporaneo.description: Reading the present world: culture, technology and person in the UP humanistic core.

optativa-i.name: Elective I
optativa-i.description: Choose a module from the Electives I · II block (all six credits in the published plan).

compiladores.name: Compilers
compiladores.description: How a language becomes executable code: lexical/syntactic analysis, semantics and code generation.

programacion-avanzada-en-paralelo.name: Advanced Parallel Programming
programacion-avanzada-en-paralelo.description: Parallelism at larger scale: performance, advanced patterns and use of parallel hardware.

emprendedores.name: Entrepreneurship
emprendedores.description: From idea to venture: validate, prototype and shape a technology-based business.

simulacion-grafica.name: Graphical Simulation
simulacion-grafica.description: Simulate phenomena and environments on screen: visual physics, real time and graphical representation of systems.

direccion-de-empresas.name: Business Management
direccion-de-empresas.description: How an organisation is led: strategy, people and operations beyond the code.

etica-profesional.name: Professional Ethics
etica-profesional.description: Engineering ethics: confidentiality, quality, conflicts of interest and responsibility to the user.

optativa-ii.name: Elective II
optativa-ii.description: Second elective from the same catalogue of six modules.

especialidad-9.name: Specialisation
especialidad-9.description: Year 4+1: one year of specialisation (two semesters) to graduate with a second degree. The plan does not publish credits for this block.

especialidad-10.name: Specialisation
especialidad-10.description: Continues the chosen specialisation. Options listed under specialties.
